description: For all \(e,x,y\in\mathbb N\), \(\varphi_e(x)\downarrow=y\) if and only if \(\exists k\,b(k,e,x)=y+1\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.UniversalComputation.phi_output (e x y : ℕ) :
  y ∈ Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.UniversalComputation.phi e x ↔
    ∃ k, Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.UniversalComputation.boundedValue k e x = y + 1
